# `clear_stack`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Discard the accumulated stack and cached calibration frame counts.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / probable (64-bit build; 32-bit build probable) |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0xcad20, ClearStack @0x1926c0 (64-bit build) |

Resets the cached stack and calibration frame counts and the selected calibration buffer, and when the current frame type is light clears the current light stack. The calibration image may be freed under a mutex. The call does not check whether Stack work is active or a camera is open, so it can change a result that is still accumulating. No force, wait or restart flag, file deletion or motor movement is established. Locks may block without a timeout. No request parameters are read.

Side effects: Clears the in-memory light stack and resets stack and calibration frame counts; may free the calibration image buffer.

## Example

Request, clear:

```json
{"id":61,"method":"clear_stack"}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"clear_stack","result":0,"code":0,"id":61}
```
